label: Starbound sandboxes
description: How Starbound sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: The executable is in win64. Workshop subscriptions are Steam's own and are not touched.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
